_note: Macrotermes (M7). Used by termites so far: nest (with the foraging holes), queen_body, founding, mound (with how often a walk may use a chimney), food (what they gather, when they go out: at night and in the rain; find_radius: how near a worker must come to a plant to find it, the colony only goes for plants its workers have found and told of; no bread; the pieces are built into fungus comb in the garden rooms; regrowth: eaten dry grass grows back green from its roots after ticks, and a tuft eaten within bare_radius blocks of a foraging hole leaves the grass block under it bare, coarse dirt, until then), garden (the garden rooms and how fast the fungus nodules grow, how the comb ages: a fresh layer ripens after about ripen_ticks, a ripe layer goes old when a nodule grows from it or after about old_ticks, an old layer nobody eats crumbles after about crumble_ticks, and the Termitomyces mushrooms that come up after rain round a colony with a healthy garden), laying (the queen's steady stream of eggs; queen meal = how many nodules she holds), the nurses, and from brood max_young, hatch_ticks, larva_meal (nodules a nymph eats) and larva_starve_ticks, and colony max_workers; soldiers (how many the colony wants per worker, minors to a major, the nodules a nymph eats to grow into a minor or a major, how often a soldier wants a nodule from a nurse, how far apart the minors stand along the foragers' trail, and how long at most they wait outside for the workers to come in when the foraging is over); alarm (how long each alarm level lasts after the last thing that raised it: 1 footsteps, 2 an enemy at the foragers, 3 a break-in, 4 repeated break-ins; how many break-ins within how long make level 4; how many more soldiers the colony wants after a level 4 and for how long; how far a soldier feels another's drumming). The queen's rich meal, burst and incubation are not used by termites; her starve_ticks is: the queen, and the king by her rule, die after that long wanting food and getting none (the king wants a nodule every worker meal_interval_ticks), here or while away, but only once the colony has had its first comb (hungry_from_first_food). worker: the workers eat once every meal_interval_ticks, slow down after slow_after_ticks without a meal and starve after starve_after_ticks; worker.diet (real Macrotermes): the young (nurse age) eat fungus nodules (nurse_food), the older ones old comb (store: a layer of comb over its bed), either eats the other kind when its own is not there, one piece makes workers_per_piece meals, and the hunger clocks only start once the colony has had its first comb (hungry_from_first_food); mouth_to_mouth: the nurses eat the nodules and feed the queen, king, soldiers and nymphs mouth to mouth from their crop, head to head, instead of carrying the nodule in their jaws; the worker ages (nurse_until_ticks, builder_until_ticks) are, for jobs by age. nest.new_holes (the user's decision): when the colony knows a rich plant (rich: true) more than min_distance blocks from every hole, the workers dig a tunnel underground to it and open a new hole beside it, plugged for good once the food is gone; the tunnels reach from reach_min blocks out (young colony) to reach_max (at reach_full_at_workers workers), the foragers range as far; at most max new holes at a time. nest.crust_walls (the user's decision, 2026-10-14): the gallery walls are thin mud crusts, plastered over every side that would open to the outside before the termites dig through it ("wall first"); a whole missing block (a player broke in) is still packed full with plug_block. nest.sheeting (mud sheeting): rich food near a hole (nearer than new_holes.min_distance) gets a covered runway of mud crust over the ground from the hole to it, at most max_length blocks long, eaten from under it by day too; at most max runways at a time; a runway crumbles once its food is gone. refuse: termites have no refuse chamber; a body younger than eat_fresh_ticks is carried into a garden and eaten (one layer of comb), an older one is walled up with soil where it lies; one nobody gets to crumbles after corpse_decay_ticks. colony (the brain, part 1): max_workers is the most workers the colony can grow to (most of them are numbers inside the nest); real_cap the most real mobs while a player is within watch_radius blocks of the nest; crew how many real workers keep working while nobody is near (the same as real_cap: the user wants a loaded colony to work just as before whether a player is near or not; lower it to save server work); swaps_per_second how many come out of the numbers or go back in each second (only where no player can see).

trails._note: The foragers' trail memory (brain step 4a): each way out the foragers use gets a trail toward the food they found, 1 stronger per visit (at most most_strength); unused, its strength halves every half_life_ticks and below fade_below it is forgotten. No trunk: Macrotermes forage under cover, through their tunnels and holes, not on bare open paths. My picks, to confirm.

galleries._note: Termites underground (docs/plans/termites-underground.md), the switch: enabled false brings back the 2 holes of before, both open every foraging time. Step 1, holes take turns: the tunnels reach out in 4 arms arm_length blocks from the middle; holes about hole_spacing blocks apart along every tunnel; each foraging time 1 hole open per foragers_per_hole foragers (at least 1), rain_more times as many again in the rain; holes with known food within food_radius blocks open first, explore of them (none if only 1 opens, 1 if 2 or 3) go to the holes rested longest (with no known food, all do). My picks, to confirm.

body_language._note: How the bodies behave (the animation engine, 2026-10-16; every number my pick, to confirm). No naps or hot ground for termites yet. notice: Macrotermes workers are blind and feel the ground shake: a player walking within range blocks, or sprinting, jumping or landing within shake_range, makes an idle worker freeze with its antennae raised for look_ticks (from, to), with chance; it never turns to look. Then it does not freeze again for rest_ticks.
